button.name: action_create_shipment_plan
button.invisible: state not in ('draft', 'failed') or inbound_plan_id or create_operation_status in ('pending', 'in_progress')

button.name: action_generate_packing_options
button.invisible: packing_generation_status in ('pending', 'in_progress') or (packing_generation_operation_id and not packing_options_expired) or not ((state == 'plan_created' and not packing_option_ids) or (state == 'packing_generated' and packing_options_expired))

button.name: action_generate_placement_options
button.invisible: placement_generation_status in ('pending', 'in_progress') or (placement_generation_operation_id and not placement_options_expired) or not ((state == 'packing_confirmed' and not placement_option_ids) or (state == 'placement_generated' and placement_options_expired))

separator.string: Local Box Details (not submitted in Phase 3)

sheet.div: Amazon QuantityReceived is cumulative per item and physical shipment. Only its validated positive delta moves from Transit to Received/Staging. Sellable, Reserved, and Unsellable disposition is not inferred here.

group.div: Shipping moves stock from the configured Source to Amazon Transit. Receiving synchronization moves only newly received quantities from Amazon Transit to Amazon Received/Staging using standard stock moves. Inventory disposition is handled by the separate reconciliation workflow.

page.div: Amazon currently exposes cumulative shipped and received quantities per physical shipment through the preserved, non-deprecated Fulfillment Inbound v0 item operation. It does not expose disposition. Received units enter Amazon Received/Staging; closed shortages and other quantity mismatches remain unresolved discrepancies.

group.div: Inbound plan creation is asynchronous. The background job polls Amazon; this page stores sanitized responses and never stores access credentials.
